title: Condensed qcqs direct image preserves copowers of a bounded-below complex
statement: Fix a prime ell and a finite intermediate field E, with the internal condensed coefficient module categories of def-weil-pbc-condensed-e-module-category. Let f:X→Y be quasi-compact and quasi-separated. Let I be any small type and M a derived E-module on X whose cohomology vanishes below N. Whenever the I-copowers of M and Rf_*M are chosen, the canonical map from the copower of Rf_*M to Rf_* of the copower of M, whose legs are Rf_* of the coprojections, is invertible. The empty indexing type is included.

source.place: Lemma 5.3(1), applied to the filtered diagram of finite subcoproducts of a strictly bounded-below representative.

proof.text: Choose a strictly bounded-below complex K representing M. Every finite subcoproduct has the same strict lower bound, by degreewise coproducts. Its projection to good truncation at N is an isomorphism, so the truncated filtered-colimit cocone is a colimit of the original finite-subcoproduct diagram.

Apply condensed_qcqs_pushforward_continuity to this diagram in each homology degree. This says the image of that colimit cocone under Q followed by Rf_* and H^q is a colimit. An additive functor preserving the filtered colimit of finite subcoproducts preserves their coproduct, by the proved universal-property helper. Transport through Q and the representative isomorphism to M.

Homology preserves coproducts in the Grothendieck derived category. On each coprojection, the composite of its coproduct comparison with homology of the Rf_* coproduct comparison is the comparison for Rf_* followed by H^q. Both outer comparisons are invertible, hence so is homology of the desired comparison. The derived homology criterion concludes. This complete Lean proof also covers empty I since its finite-subset category is still filtered.

lean.statement:
theorem condensedSubfield_bounded_copower_comparison
    (ℓ : ℕ) [Fact ℓ.Prime] (E : PadicAlgCl.FiniteIntermediateField ℓ)
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) [QuasiCompact f] [QuasiSeparated f]
    (I : Type (u + 1))
    (M : DerivedCategory (Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology X) Ab.{u + 1})
      (condensedRingObj (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj E) X)))
    (N : ℤ) [M.IsGE N]
    [HasCoproduct (fun _ : I ↦ M)]
    [HasCoproduct (fun _ : I ↦
      R((f)_*⟦Profinite.continuousMapRingObj E⟧).obj M)] :
    IsIso (Sigma.desc fun i : I ↦
      R((f)_*⟦Profinite.continuousMapRingObj E⟧).map
        (Sigma.ι (fun _ : I ↦ M) i))
